controlsRationale: Original Space release starts from menu, WASD releases turn the snake, Escape exits. Mobile Start button emits ordinary Space and WASD is directly accessible; no calibrated direct-pointer preset or unnecessary mouse pad. Original physical mouse menu controls remain available. Source mouse speed1.7 remains unchanged.

artwork.icon: Original snakeBody/snakeHead BMP tiles enlarged nearest-neighbor on a simple dark-green square. Original assets unchanged.
artwork.preview: Actual final-source screenshot after visible food consumption and growth, cropped to the original board with20px margin.

verification.browser: Ordinary mobile Start and WASD steering. Screenshot-only observer reads rendered head/body/fruit cells, sends ordinary touchscreen directions and sees real growth3→4 after consuming visible food. Original RNG/clock/art/state unchanged. Portrait/landscape panel inspected.
verification.limitations: No full-board victory or fixed RNG/score promise. Original source saves scores on collision without an in-game score HUD.

nativeGameplay.demonstrated: ROOT visually reviewed all five Android frames: original menu, ordinary Start release enters original board with three-cell snake, S turns down, D turns right with visibly four-cell snake after natural food encounter, then authored Escape ends isolated game and returns to same launcher. Independent screenshot component measurements show snake width68 pixels initially and91 pixels after growth, with unchanged23-pixel cell height. ROOT also viewed browser portrait/landscape controls and all three canonical real gameplay frames.
limitations: Representative steering, one natural growth and normal exit demonstrated. Full-board survival, special-food scoring and collision score persistence are not qualified through Android gameplay. Original centered500-pixel board within1024x768 framebuffer is preserved; portrait viewport therefore has a small playing board. No RNG, clock, rules or artwork was changed.
